answer: Each identity must keep a small island of standing inside a shared nebula of attestations: every epoch, a random comet of verification work — a real task with a short deadline — is thrown at the island, and only its owner can catch it, because the work is chained to that identity's own key and history. A fake island has no history to chain to, so its comet burns out unanswered; each extra fake costs a full fresh island of weeks of real work, and no operator can tend a thousand islands at once.
